mapper.update: update im_conversation set last_msg_text = null where last_msg_text is not null and id in (select m.conversation_id from im_message m where m.sender_id = #{memberId} and m.id = (select max(x.id) from im_message x where x.conversation_id = m.conversation_id))
mapper.insert: insert into im_message_mutation(conversation_id, message_id, version, kind) select m.conversation_id, m.id, m.version + 1, 'RECALL' from im_message m where m.sender_id = #{memberId} and m.status = 0 and m.conversation_id in (select c.id from im_channel c)
mapper.update: update im_message_revision set content = null where content is not null and message_id in (select m.id from im_message m where m.sender_id = #{memberId})
mapper.delete: delete from im_message_pin where message_id in (select m.id from im_message m where m.sender_id = #{memberId} and m.status = 0)
mapper.update: update im_message set content = '', extra_json = null, version = version + 1, status = case when status = 0 then 1 else status end where sender_id = #{memberId} and (status = 0 or extra_json is not null or (content is not null and content <> ''))
update im_channel_op_log set operator_id = null where operator_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: select id from im_message where conversation_id = #{channelId} order by id limit #{limit}
mapper.delete: delete from im_message_reaction where message_id in #{i}
delete from im_message_mention where message_id in #{i}
delete from im_message_ref where message_id in #{i}
delete from im_message_revision where message_id in #{i}
delete from im_message where id in #{i}
mapper.update: update im_conversation set last_msg_text = null, status = 1 where id = #{channelId}
